Renamed “Columbia” after independence. | | **Location** | Morningside Heights neighborhood of Manhattan, NYC; also has campuses at Fort Lee, NJ (College of Physicians & Surgeons) and several satellite sites worldwide. | | **Type** | Private, co‑educational Ivy League research institution. | | **Campus Size** | ~36 acres in Manhattan; additional facilities across NY/NJ/NYC. | | **Student Body** | ≈15,000 undergraduate students; ≈30,000 graduate/professional students. | | **Academic Structure** | • Faculty of Arts & Sciences

Often placed within the top 10–20 institutions worldwide. | | **Notable Alumni / Faculty** | • Alexander Hamilton (founder of Federalist Party)
